---
title: "Customised density"
description: "Filled contours with a custom colormap, levels and threshold."
date: 2026-01-04
categories: [density, customisation]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-customised-density
#| fig-alt: "Customised density plot"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import soundscapy as sspy

data = pd.read_csv("../../assets/DemoData.csv")

sspy.density(
    data,
    title="Customised density plot",
    diagonal_lines=True,
    fill=True,
    alpha=0.6,
    levels=8,
    thresh=0.1,
    cmap="viridis",
    incl_scatter=False,
)
plt.show()
```
